name: Inoguchi Wataru
source:
He is a soldier dispatched to the island from the mainland, but he actually originally comes from a distinguished family on the island. He wishes to somehow ease the situation of his younger brother [url=/c43292]Noa[/url], who was born to a different mother from a foreign country and has been discriminated against by the islanders for a long time.

[From [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/04/17/getsuei-no-kusari/]Otome Jikan[/url]]
